moves.title: Stripe agrees to buy stablecoin platform Bridge for a reported $1.1bn
moves.summary: Stripe confirmed it is buying Bridge, founded in 2022 by Coinbase alumni, in a deal reported at $1.1bn and subject to regulatory approval. Bridge said it had processed $5bn a year since launch, with clients including SpaceX.

deal.rationale: build stablecoin payments into Stripe

moves.title: Tether, Kraken and Fabric back Quantoz as it issues EURQ and USDQ
moves.summary: Utrecht-based Quantoz Payments took investment from Fabric Ventures, Kraken and Tether as it began issuing EURQ and USDQ, euro and dollar tokens designed to comply with MiCA, on Ethereum, with listings planned on Bitfinex and Kraken.

moves.title: Paxos agrees to buy Finnish e-money institution Membrane Finance
moves.summary: Paxos agreed to buy Membrane Finance, a Finnish e-money institution, to become a fully licensed EMI in Finland and the EU and issue MiCA-compliant stablecoins for European clients, subject to regulatory approval.

deal.rationale: an EU e-money licence to issue MiCA-compliant stablecoins

moves.title: KAST raises $10m seed led by HSG and Peak XV
moves.summary: KAST, a stablecoin platform offering payment cards and US dollar accounts in over 150 countries with partners such as Bridge, raised a $10m seed led by HSG and Peak XV, with partners of DST Global and Goodwater Capital.

round.use_of_funds: savings and remittance products on top of its cards and dollar accounts

moves.title: BVNK raises $50m Series B led by Haun Ventures
moves.summary: London stablecoin payments firm BVNK raised a $50m Series B led by Haun Ventures, with Coinbase Ventures, Scribble Ventures, DRW Venture Capital and existing investors Avenir and Tiger Global, and set out plans to expand in the US in 2025.

round.use_of_funds: growth, including expansion in the US

moves.title: Tether invests in European stablecoin issuer StablR
moves.summary: Tether made an undisclosed investment in StablR, issuer of the EURR and USDR stablecoins, saying it backs fully regulated stablecoins in Europe as a wave of euro token launches gets under way.

moves.title: MoonPay buys Solana payment processor Helio for $175m
moves.summary: MoonPay acquired Helio, a Solana-based crypto payment processor serving over 6,000 merchants with more than $1.5bn of transactions, in a $175m deal to widen its payments offering for merchants and marketplaces.

deal.rationale: crypto payments for merchants and marketplaces

moves.title: 1Money emerges with over $20m seed for a stablecoin payments chain
moves.summary: 1Money came out of stealth with more than $20m of seed capital, with Hack VC among its backers, to launch the 1Money Network, a layer 1 protocol built for stablecoin payments that it planned to open in the second quarter.

round.use_of_funds: launching the 1Money Network

moves.title: Komainu raises $75m Series B from Blockstream, paid in bitcoin
moves.summary: Custodian Komainu, backed by Nomura's Laser Digital, raised $75m from Blockstream Capital Partners, funded in bitcoin, to speed international growth and adopt Blockstream technology for collateral management and tokenisation.

round.use_of_funds: international growth and Blockstream technology for collateral management and tokenisation

moves.title: Phantom raises $150m Series C at a $3bn valuation
moves.summary: Crypto wallet Phantom raised $150m in a Series C led by Sequoia Capital and Paradigm at a $3bn valuation. It claimed 15m active users and $20bn of annual trading volume.

round.use_of_funds: new features for its wallet, including social discovery

moves.title: Circle buys Hashnote, issuer of the USYC tokenised money fund
moves.summary: Circle acquired Hashnote, issuer of USYC, then the largest tokenised treasury and money market fund with $1.52bn deployed, and agreed a strategic partnership with DRW affiliate Cumberland.

deal.rationale: a tokenised money market fund to sit beside USDC in capital markets

moves.title: QED leads $9.9m seed in stablecoin payments firm Cedar Money
moves.summary: US-based Cedar Money, which runs cross-border payments on stablecoins behind a fiat-facing service, raised a $9.9m seed led by QED Investors with Lattice, NIV, Stellar and Wischoff Ventures.

round.use_of_funds: scaling its payment infrastructure

moves.title: Bastion gains a New York trust charter by buying Dibbs Trust Company
moves.summary: Stablecoin infrastructure firm Bastion secured a New York limited purpose trust charter from NYDFS by acquiring Dibbs Trust Company, to launch a white-label stablecoin issuance platform.

moves.title: Stripe completes its acquisition of Bridge
moves.summary: Stripe completed its purchase of stablecoin platform Bridge, which it had agreed to buy in October 2024; Bridge co-founder Zach Abrams confirmed the close.

deal.rationale: build stablecoin payments into Stripe

moves.title: Limited raises $3m pre-seed for stablecoin-based banking
moves.summary: Limited, founded by Hussein Ahmed to offer premium global banking services on stablecoins with self-custody, raised a $3m pre-seed led by Third Prime, with The House Fund and Arche Capital.

moves.title: Plasma raises $24m to build a blockchain for stablecoins
moves.summary: Plasma raised $24m in its first round, led by Framework Ventures with Bitfinex, Peter Thiel and Tether chief executive Paolo Ardoino, to launch a blockchain built for fast, zero-fee USDT transfers.

round.use_of_funds: launching the Plasma blockchain

moves.title: Dubai's Mansa raises $10m seed led by Tether for stablecoin liquidity
moves.summary: Dubai-based Mansa, which lends payment companies stablecoin liquidity on a revolving line, raised $10m: a $3m equity round led by Tether with Faculty Group, Octerra, Polymorphic and Trive Digital, plus $7m of liquidity.

round.use_of_funds: stablecoin liquidity for payment companies' settlement and pre-funding

moves.title: Mesh raises $82m Series B led by Paradigm, settled in PYUSD
moves.summary: Crypto payments network Mesh closed an $82m Series B led by Paradigm, with Consensys, QuantumLight and Yolo Investments, paid largely in the PYUSD stablecoin, taking its total raised past $120m.

round.use_of_funds: building out its global crypto payments network

moves.title: Abu Dhabi's MGX invests $2bn in Binance, paid in a stablecoin
moves.summary: Abu Dhabi investment firm MGX invested $2bn in Binance, paid in a stablecoin. It was the exchange's first institutional investment and MGX's first digital-asset deal; Binance has around 1,000 staff in Abu Dhabi.

moves.title: MoonPay buys stablecoin infrastructure platform Iron
moves.summary: MoonPay acquired Iron, an API-first stablecoin infrastructure platform, to offer businesses multi-currency treasury, instant cross-border payments and yield, after buying Solana payment processor Helio. Iron later became MoonPay Enterprise.

deal.rationale: enterprise stablecoin treasury and cross-border payments

moves.title: RedotPay raises $40m Series A led by Lightspeed
moves.summary: Hong Kong crypto card and payments platform RedotPay, founded in 2023, raised a $40m Series A led by Lightspeed, with HSG, Galaxy Ventures, DST Global Partners, Accel and Temasek-backed Vertex Ventures.

round.use_of_funds: a wider payment ecosystem, new products, stronger compliance and more licences

moves.title: Crossmint raises $23.6m led by Ribbit Capital
moves.summary: Crossmint, which sells one platform for wallets, stablecoins and payments to businesses and AI agents, raised $23.6m led by Ribbit Capital. It holds a virtual asset service provider licence and has a MiCA licence under way.

round.use_of_funds: bringing businesses and AI agents on-chain

moves.title: Wallet infrastructure firm Privy raises about $15m led by Ribbit
moves.summary: Privy, whose APIs let apps give users crypto wallets, raised an estimated $15m led by Ribbit Capital with Sequoia, Paradigm, BlueYard and Coinbase, taking its total funding past $40m.

round.use_of_funds: crypto onboarding rails for developers

moves.title: Stable Sea exits stealth with $3.5m for corporate stablecoin flows
moves.summary: Stable Sea came out of stealth with a $3.5m raise for an orchestration platform that gives corporate treasurers a fiat off-ramp and a dashboard for cross-border stablecoin payments, routing data rather than holding funds.

round.use_of_funds: stablecoin orchestration for corporate treasurers

moves.title: Utila raises $18m Series A as stablecoin demand lifts MPC wallets
moves.summary: Utila, which runs MPC wallets and digital asset operations for payment firms, fintechs and neobanks, raised an $18m Series A led by Nyca Partners. It said it processed $8bn in a month and will expand globally.

round.use_of_funds: global expansion, gas management, API integrations and smart contract support

moves.title: NymCard raises $33m Series B led by QED Investors
moves.summary: Dubai card-issuing and embedded finance platform NymCard raised $33m led by QED Investors, its first Gulf investment, with Lunate, Dubai Future District Fund, Mashreq Bank, Shorooq, Oraseya Capital and others, taking its total to nearly $70m.

round.use_of_funds: deeper presence across 10+ MENA markets

moves.title: Rain raises $24.5m Series A led by Norwest
moves.summary: Stablecoin card issuer Rain raised $24.5m led by Norwest Venture Partners, with new backers Galaxy Ventures, Goldcrest, Thayer and Hard Yaka joining Lightspeed, Coinbase Ventures and other existing investors.

round.use_of_funds: more interoperability with existing rails, a wider footprint and its stablecoin authorisation and settlement infrastructure

moves.title: Damisa raises £2.25m pre-seed for stablecoin payments and escrow
moves.summary: Damisa, a payments platform co-founded by Volt's Jordan Lawrence, raised £2.25m led by Fuel Ventures with EWOR and Greyhound Capital; its first customer uses Damisa's wallets in place of escrow services.

round.use_of_funds: stablecoin payment and escrow wallets

moves.title: Codex raises $15.8m seed led by Dragonfly for a stablecoin chain
moves.summary: Codex, which is building a blockchain designed for stablecoins, raised a $15.8m seed of equity and token warrants led by Dragonfly, which put in about $14m, with the venture arms of Coinbase and Circle.

round.use_of_funds: a blockchain built for stablecoin payments

moves.title: Ripple buys prime broker Hidden Road for $1.25bn
moves.summary: Ripple agreed to buy Hidden Road, a prime broker offering clearing and financing across FX, digital assets, derivatives and fixed income, for $1.25bn, becoming the first crypto firm to own a global multi-asset prime broker.

deal.rationale: institutional prime brokerage, with RLUSD used as collateral

moves.title: Swapped.com buys Web3 payments firm Kado Software
moves.summary: Crypto on-ramp Swapped.com acquired Kado Software, a Web3 payments infrastructure provider, on undisclosed terms. Kado founder Emery Andrew leads Swapped's US operations and product expansion.

deal.rationale: a larger US presence and new crypto-native payment products

moves.title: Circle turns down a $4bn to $5bn takeover offer from Ripple
moves.summary: Ripple, issuer of the RLUSD stablecoin, offered $4bn to $5bn to buy USDC issuer Circle, Bloomberg reported. Circle rejected the offer as too low while it prepared to go public.

deal.rationale: Circle rejected the offer as too low

moves.title: OpenFX emerges with $23m led by Accel for round-the-clock FX
moves.summary: OpenFX came out of stealth with a $23m round led by Accel, with Castle Island Ventures and Hash3, to run instant cross-border payments around the clock. It claimed $10bn of annualised payment volume already.

moves.title: Fuze raises $12.2m Series A co-led by Galaxy and e& capital
moves.summary: UAE-based Fuze, which supplies digital asset and stablecoin infrastructure to banks, fintechs and firms in the Middle East and Turkey, raised $12.2m co-led by Galaxy and e& capital, with Further Ventures, for expansion, products and hiring.

round.use_of_funds: regional and international expansion, product development, compliance and hiring

moves.title: Visa makes strategic investment in BVNK
moves.summary: Visa invested an undisclosed sum in London stablecoin payments infrastructure firm BVNK through Visa Ventures, five months after BVNK's $50m Series B led by Haun Ventures.

moves.title: Anchorage Digital to buy USDM issuer Mountain Protocol
moves.summary: Federally chartered crypto bank Anchorage Digital agreed to buy Mountain Protocol, issuer of the USDM stablecoin, to support institutional stablecoin adoption. Terms were not disclosed and the deal needs regulatory approval.

deal.rationale: institutional stablecoin issuance

moves.title: Catena Labs raises $18m led by a16z crypto for an AI-native bank
moves.summary: Catena Labs, led by Circle co-founder Sean Neville, raised $18m led by a16z crypto to build a regulated financial institution for AI agents, using regulated stablecoins such as USDC as its money.

round.use_of_funds: a regulated financial institution for AI agents

moves.title: Founders Fund makes strategic investment in Plasma
moves.summary: Founders Fund made a strategic investment in Plasma, the stablecoin blockchain, to help it grow its team and ecosystem in regions from Latin America to the Middle East. Peter Thiel was one of Plasma's earliest angel investors.

round.use_of_funds: team, ecosystem and adoption in Latin America and the Middle East

moves.title: Conduit raises $36m Series A co-led by Dragonfly and Altos
moves.summary: Boston-based Conduit, which runs cross-border payments on stablecoins alongside local rails, raised a $36m Series A co-led by Dragonfly and Altos Ventures, with Circle Ventures and Digital Currency Group among the backers.

round.use_of_funds: expanding its global payment rails

moves.title: Velocity emerges with $10m pre-seed led by Activant
moves.summary: London's Velocity, founded by Tom Greenwood and Eric Queathem, raised a $10m pre-seed led by Activant Capital, with Fuel, Triton, Fabric, Commerce, Digital Space and Preface, and launched a Stablecoin Payment Account.

round.use_of_funds: platform development and global expansion

moves.title: Circle raises $1.05bn in upsized NYSE listing
moves.summary: USDC issuer Circle priced its twice-upsized IPO at $31 a share, raising $1.05bn and valuing the company at about $8.06bn, ahead of trading on the New York Stock Exchange.

moves.title: Limited raises $7m seed led by North Island Ventures
moves.summary: Self-custody stablecoin banking start-up Limited raised a $7m seed led by North Island Ventures, with Third Prime, Arche Capital, Collab+Currency and SevenX Ventures, taking its total to $10m.

round.use_of_funds: growth in Latin America, South-East Asia and the Middle East

moves.title: Turnkey raises $30m Series B led by Bain Capital Crypto
moves.summary: Wallet infrastructure firm Turnkey, which powers more than 50m embedded wallets with secure key management, raised $30m led by Bain Capital Crypto with Sequoia, Lightspeed Faction, Galaxy Ventures, Wintermute Ventures and Variant.

moves.title: Noah raises $22m seed led by LocalGlobe and adds Adyen's Thijn Lamers
moves.summary: Stablecoin payments start-up Noah raised a $22m seed led by LocalGlobe with Felix Capital, FJ Labs and angels including Joe Lonsdale, as former Adyen executive Thijn Lamers joined as president and co-founder.

moves.title: London's OpenTrade raises $7m for stablecoin yield products
moves.summary: OpenTrade, which gives fintechs yield-bearing stablecoin products backed by real-world assets, raised $7m co-led by Notion Capital and Mercury Fund with a16z crypto, AlbionVC and CMCC Global, taking its total to $11m.

round.use_of_funds: yield-bearing stablecoin products in Latin America and Europe

moves.title: Stripe agrees to buy wallet infrastructure firm Privy
moves.summary: Stripe agreed to buy Privy, whose embedded wallets serve over 75m accounts and 1,000 developer teams, its second major crypto deal after Bridge. Privy will run as an independent product; terms were not disclosed.

deal.rationale: embedded crypto wallets for Stripe's stablecoin products

moves.title: Stablecoin clearing start-up Ubyx raises $10m led by Galaxy
moves.summary: Ubyx, founded by former Citi executive Tony McLaughlin to clear stablecoins through regulated banks, raised a $10m seed led by Galaxy Ventures with Coinbase Ventures, Founders Fund, Paxos and VanEck.

round.use_of_funds: a global stablecoin clearing system

moves.title: Canton builder Digital Asset raises $135m led by DRW and Tradeweb
moves.summary: Digital Asset, which builds the privacy-focused Canton Network, raised $135m co-led by DRW Venture Capital and Tradeweb with BNP Paribas, Circle Ventures, Citadel Securities, DTCC, IMC, Virtu and Paxos.

round.use_of_funds: bringing more real-world assets onto Canton

moves.title: Monad Foundation buys stablecoin wallet platform Portal
moves.summary: The Monad Foundation acquired Portal Labs, whose embedded wallets let businesses and banks accept stablecoin payments. Portal CEO Raj Parekh, formerly of Visa, becomes Monad's head of payments and stablecoins.

deal.rationale: stablecoin payments on the Monad blockchain

moves.title: Agora raises $50m Series A led by Paradigm
moves.summary: Agora, issuer of the AUSD dollar stablecoin and a white-label issuance service, raised a $50m Series A led by Paradigm, a year after a $12m seed round.

round.use_of_funds: growing AUSD and white-label issuance

moves.title: Dakota raises $12.5m Series A led by CoinFund for stablecoin banking
moves.summary: Dakota, a stablecoin-powered business banking platform co-founded by former Coinbase executive Ryan Bozarth, raised a $12.5m equity Series A led by CoinFund with 6th Man Ventures, Triton Ventures and Digital Currency Group.

moves.title: Trump signs the GENIUS Act, the first US stablecoin law
moves.summary: President Trump signed the GENIUS Act, the Senate's stablecoin bill as passed by the House, into law, creating a federal regulatory framework for dollar-backed payment stablecoins.

moves.title: Kraken makes strategic investment in StablR
moves.summary: Kraken made an undisclosed strategic investment in StablR, whose EURR and USDR stablecoins are listed on more than 50 exchanges and passed $3bn of transaction volume in the first half of 2025.

moves.title: Spiko raises $22m led by Index Ventures for tokenised cash funds
moves.summary: French start-up Spiko, which issues tokenised money market funds, raised $22m led by Index Ventures, with angels including Revolut's Nikolay Storonsky and Wise CTO Harsh Sinha. It held almost $400m after less than a year.

moves.title: Zodia Markets raises $18.25m Series A for stablecoin payments push
moves.summary: Zodia Markets, the crypto trading firm majority-owned by Standard Chartered, raised $18.25m led by Pharsalus Capital with Circle Ventures, The Operating Group and XVC Tech, for international expansion and stablecoin payment services.

round.use_of_funds: international expansion and stablecoin payment services

moves.title: Plasma's XPL public sale draws $373m against a $50m target
moves.summary: Stablecoin chain Plasma closed a 10-day public sale of its XPL token with $373m of commitments from over 2,900 wallets, more than seven times its $50m target, at a $500m valuation.

moves.title: USDT chain Stable raises $28m seed led by Bitfinex and Hack VC
moves.summary: Stable, a layer-1 blockchain powered by USDT, closed a $28m seed led by Bitfinex and Hack VC with Franklin Templeton, Castle Island Ventures, Susquehanna Crypto and others, to grow its infrastructure and USDT distribution.

round.use_of_funds: infrastructure, staff and USDT distribution

moves.title: Ripple agrees to buy stablecoin payments platform Rail for $200m
moves.summary: Ripple agreed to acquire Rail, a stablecoin-based global payments platform, for $200m, to offer a complete stablecoin payments service to businesses.

deal.rationale: a complete stablecoin payments service

moves.title: Transak raises $16m led by Tether and IDG Capital
moves.summary: On- and off-ramp provider Transak, which has processed over $2bn with nearly 30% in stablecoins, raised $16m co-led by Tether and IDG Capital with Primal Capital, 1kx, Fuel Ventures and others to expand its stablecoin payments stack.

round.use_of_funds: its stablecoin payments stack and new markets

moves.title: Circle buys the Malachite consensus engine to power its Arc chain
moves.summary: Circle acquired Malachite, the consensus engine set to underpin its Arc payments blockchain, from Informal Systems, including the technology and IP; nine Informal Systems staff joined Circle. Terms were not disclosed.

deal.rationale: consensus technology for the Arc blockchain

moves.title: Tazapay closes Series B with Ripple and Circle as investors
moves.summary: Singapore cross-border payments platform Tazapay closed a Series B led by Peak XV with Ripple, Circle Ventures, Norinchukin Capital and GMO VenturePartners. Licensed in Singapore, Canada and the EU, it is applying in the UAE and the US.

round.use_of_funds: licences in more markets, including the UAE, the US and Hong Kong

moves.title: M0 raises $40m Series B led by Polychain and Ribbit
moves.summary: M0, which builds infrastructure that lets many issuers mint interoperable stablecoins, raised $40m of equity and locked tokens led by Polychain and Ribbit Capital, with Endeavor Catalyst, Pantera and Bain Capital Crypto; it has raised almost $100m.

round.use_of_funds: its stablecoin network for issuers

moves.title: Rain raises $58m Series B led by Sapphire Ventures
moves.summary: Rain raised a $58m Series B led by Sapphire Ventures, with Dragonfly, Galaxy, Endeavor Catalyst, Samsung Next, Lightspeed and Norwest, five months after its Series A, taking its total to $88.5m; volume had grown 10x since January.

round.use_of_funds: hiring in engineering, commercial and compliance teams, scaling partner programmes and entering new markets

moves.title: Kite raises $18m for stablecoin payments by AI agents
moves.summary: San Francisco-based Kite, which gives AI agents verified identities, spending rules and stablecoin payment rails, raised an $18m Series A co-led by General Catalyst and PayPal Ventures, taking its total to $33m.

round.use_of_funds: tools for agents to transact at machine speed

moves.title: Utila adds $22m Series A extension led by Red Dot
moves.summary: Red Dot Capital Partners led a $22m extension of Utila's Series A, with Nyca, Wing VC, DCG, Cerca Partners, Funfair Ventures and SilverCircle, taking the round to $40m and total funding past $51m; Utila says its valuation nearly tripled.

moves.title: Lead Bank raises $70m Series B led by ICONIQ and Greycroft
moves.summary: Lead Bank, a state-chartered bank providing banking infrastructure to fintechs and digital asset firms, raised $70m led by ICONIQ and Greycroft with Ribbit Capital, Coatue, Khosla Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz and Zeev Ventures.

moves.title: Tetra raises C$10m from banks and fintechs for a CAD stablecoin
moves.summary: Tetra Trust's new parent, Tetra Digital Group, closed C$10m of equity from Urbana, ATB Financial, National Bank, Purpose, Shakepay, Shopify and Wealthsimple to launch a Canadian-dollar stablecoin; about 30% was secondary for early investors.

round.use_of_funds: a Canadian-dollar stablecoin and its Tetra Unity software

moves.title: dLocal joins the Fireblocks Network for fiat-stablecoin rails
moves.summary: Emerging-markets payments firm dLocal joined the Fireblocks Network for Payments, giving institutions a partner for on- and off-ramps and easier access to liquidity providers among more than 2,400 participants.

moves.title: Gemini raises $425m in its IPO at a $3.3bn valuation
moves.summary: Crypto exchange Gemini priced its IPO at $28 a share, above a range it had already raised, selling 15.2m shares for $425m at a value of about $3.3bn. Nasdaq agreed to buy $50m of its stock in a private placement.

moves.title: MoonPay buys payments start-up Meso
moves.summary: MoonPay acquired payments start-up Meso, confirming the deal on X, to help build what it called crypto's largest global payments network. No financial terms were given; it follows MoonPay's $175m purchase of Helio in January.

deal.rationale: a global crypto payments network

moves.title: Stablecore raises $20m led by Norwest to bring stablecoins to banks
moves.summary: Dallas-based Stablecore, founded in 2025, raised $20m led by Norwest Venture Partners, with Coinbase Ventures, Curql, BankTech Ventures, Bank of Utah, EJF Ventures and funds representing over 290 banks and credit unions.

round.use_of_funds: letting community and regional banks and credit unions offer stablecoins and tokenised deposits

moves.title: Brale raises $30m led by Lightspeed
moves.summary: Stablecoin issuance platform Brale raised $30m led by Lightspeed with NEA, Refract and angels from Cloudflare, Rain, Tempo and Coinflow, to fund research, regulatory work and incubation and acquisitions at Brale Holdings.

round.use_of_funds: research and development, regulatory work, incubation and M&A

moves.title: Shield raises $5m seed for cross-border trade payments in stablecoins
moves.summary: Shield, which lets exporters and importers pay across borders in dollar stablecoins with compliance screening, raised a $5m seed led by Giant Ventures with a16z crypto's accelerator and Factor Capital, having processed over $100m.

round.use_of_funds: more banking partnerships

moves.title: PayPal Ventures invests in USDT chain Stable, adding PYUSD
moves.summary: PayPal Ventures invested in Stable, a layer-1 blockchain powered by USDT, which is bringing PayPal USD onto its network. It follows Stable's $28m seed round backed by Bitfinex and Hack VC.

round.use_of_funds: PYUSD distribution and liquidity

moves.title: Fnality raises $136m Series C with Bank of America and Citi
moves.summary: Fnality, which runs the central bank-regulated Sterling Fnality Payment System, raised $136m led by WisdomTree, Bank of America, Citi, KBC, Temasek and Tradeweb, with Santander, Barclays, Goldman Sachs, UBS and other existing backers.

round.use_of_funds: more currencies, better liquidity management and links to stablecoins and tokenised deposits

moves.title: Tether in talks to raise up to $20bn at a $500bn valuation
moves.summary: Tether was reported to be seeking $15bn to $20bn for about 3% of the company in a private placement, valuing it near $500bn. The talks were early, with investors given data-room access; it reported $4.9bn of second-quarter profit.

moves.title: zerohash raises $104m at a $1bn valuation led by Interactive Brokers
moves.summary: Crypto and stablecoin infrastructure firm zerohash raised a $104m Series D-2 at a $1bn valuation led by Interactive Brokers, with Morgan Stanley, Apollo-managed funds, SoFi, Jump Crypto and others, taking total funding to $275m.

moves.title: Bastion raises $14.6m led by Coinbase Ventures
moves.summary: Bastion, which provides regulated stablecoin issuance, reserve and liquidity services, raised $14.6m led by Coinbase Ventures with Sony Innovation Fund, a16z crypto, Samsung Next and Hashed, taking its total past $40m.

round.use_of_funds: adoption of its stablecoin products

moves.title: Circle Ventures makes strategic investment in Crossmint
moves.summary: Circle Ventures made a strategic investment in Crossmint, which combines its wallets and APIs for stablecoin on-ramps, orchestration and agent payments with USDC.

round.use_of_funds: stablecoin payments for fintechs, enterprises and AI agents

moves.title: Stablecorp raises about C$5m led by FTP Ventures for QCAD
moves.summary: Toronto-based Stablecorp, which runs the QCAD Canadian-dollar stablecoin, raised about C$5m in a follow-on round led by FTP Ventures with existing and new shareholders, after a round earlier in 2025 led by Coinbase Ventures.

round.use_of_funds: rolling out QCAD

moves.title: Cloudflare plans NET Dollar stablecoin for AI agent payments
moves.summary: Cloudflare announced NET Dollar, a US dollar-backed stablecoin for instant, global online payments and microtransactions by AI agents; CEO Matthew Prince said stablecoin payments could replace ads and bank transfers.

moves.title: RedotPay raises $47m with Coinbase Ventures and passes $1bn value
moves.summary: RedotPay, founded in 2023, which offers stablecoin cards, multicurrency wallets and payouts, raised a $47m strategic round with Coinbase Ventures, Galaxy Ventures and Vertex Ventures, and said it is now valued at over $1bn.

round.use_of_funds: global expansion

moves.title: Abu Dhabi's M2 Capital invests $20m in Ethena
moves.summary: UAE-based M2 Capital invested $20m in Ethena, whose USDe synthetic dollar and yield-bearing sUSDe had drawn over $14bn since 2024, and plans to add Ethena products to its wealth management services.

moves.title: DeFi Technologies makes strategic investment in Stablecorp
moves.summary: DeFi Technologies made a strategic investment in Stablecorp, joining Coinbase Ventures, Circle Ventures and Side Door Ventures as backers of the QCAD Canadian-dollar stablecoin.

round.use_of_funds: scaling QCAD adoption

moves.title: Paxos Labs and Aleo launch USAD, a private dollar stablecoin
moves.summary: Paxos Labs and the Aleo Network Foundation launched USAD, a dollar stablecoin that encrypts transaction data end to end, aimed at institutions that want private, programmable digital dollars.

moves.title: Brex adds stablecoin payments for its business customers
moves.summary: Brex, with over 30,000 business clients, added sending and receiving USDC with automatic conversion to dollars for international payments, and lets companies top up corporate cards with stablecoins.

moves.title: Sony Bank applies to the OCC for Connectia Trust
moves.summary: Sony Bank applied to the OCC on 6 October to set up Connectia Trust, a limited-purpose national trust bank in New York focused on crypto, positioning it to issue a dollar stablecoin under federal oversight.

moves.title: Labuan FSA gives Fasset conditional approval for a stablecoin Islamic digital bank
moves.summary: Labuan's regulator gave Fasset Islamic Digital Bank Limited a conditional approval in its Islamic digital bank sandbox; it may not start business until it meets every operational and prudential requirement. Fasset had described it as a Malaysian banking licence.

moves.title: U.S. Bank to hold reserves behind Anchorage's payment stablecoins
moves.summary: U.S. Bank, with $11.7tn in custody, was chosen to hold the reserves backing the GENIUS Act-compliant payment stablecoins Anchorage Digital Bank began issuing in July 2025.

moves.title: Coinflow raises $25m Series A led by Pantera for stablecoin payouts
moves.summary: Chicago-based Coinflow, whose infrastructure lets businesses accept and send money with stablecoins such as USDC in 170+ countries, raised a $25m Series A led by Pantera Capital with Coinbase Ventures, after growing revenue 23-fold since 2024.

round.use_of_funds: payout coverage in Asia and Latin America, hiring and approval rates

moves.title: Bank of North Dakota plans Roughrider Coin stablecoin with Fiserv
moves.summary: The state-owned Bank of North Dakota will launch Roughrider Coin, a dollar stablecoin for banks and credit unions in the state, in 2026. It runs on Fiserv's digital asset platform and its white-label FIUSD system.

moves.title: Citi Ventures invests in BVNK, valuing it above $750m
moves.summary: Citi Ventures made a strategic investment of undisclosed size in London-based BVNK, pushing its valuation above $750m, its co-founder told CNBC, months after Visa Ventures backed the firm.

round.use_of_funds: scaling stablecoin payment infrastructure globally

moves.title: Routefusion raises $26.5m Series A for cross-border payment rails
moves.summary: Austin-based Routefusion, which links fragmented payment rails for cross-border transfers through one API, raised a $26.5m Series A led by PeakSpan Capital with Silverton Partners, taking its total to $40.7m.

round.use_of_funds: partner network, liquidity and compliance

moves.title: Brussels declines ECB push to restrict multi-issuance stablecoins
moves.summary: The European Commission signalled on 10 October that it would not add restrictions on stablecoin firms that treat tokens issued inside and outside the EU as interchangeable, rejecting the ECB's call for tighter MiCA rules.

moves.title: Ten global banks explore reserve-backed tokens in G7 currencies
moves.summary: Ten of the world's largest banks, including Bank of America, Santander, BNP Paribas, Citi, Deutsche Bank and Goldman Sachs, said they will explore issuing 1:1 reserve-backed digital money on public blockchains in G7 currencies.

moves.title: Legend Trading wins MiCA licence in Ireland and launches Legend FXN
moves.summary: Legend Trading was authorised as a crypto-asset service provider by the Central Bank of Ireland under MiCA and unveiled Legend FXN, a regulated stablecoin-to-fiat settlement hub.

moves.title: Bitpanda offers SG-FORGE's euro and dollar stablecoins to retail users
moves.summary: SG-FORGE and Bitpanda widened their partnership so Bitpanda's DeFi wallet offers SG-FORGE's EUR and USD CoinVertible stablecoins to retail users across Europe for the first time, with on-chain lending and borrowing.

moves.title: Erebor wins conditional OCC approval for a national bank charter
moves.summary: The OCC granted conditional national bank status to Erebor, a tech-sector bank aiming to serve crypto and venture-backed companies. The regulator said the decision shows it is open to digital asset activity at the banks it oversees.

moves.title: French bank ODDO BHF launches EUROD, a MiCA euro stablecoin
moves.summary: ODDO BHF, the Franco-German financial group, launched EUROD, a euro stablecoin built to comply with MiCA, with a listing on Madrid-based crypto platform Bit2Me, whose backers include Telefónica, Unicaja and BBVA.

moves.title: Ripple buys treasury software firm GTreasury for $1bn
moves.summary: Ripple agreed a $1bn acquisition of GTreasury, a treasury management system provider, opening the corporate treasury market and its large corporate clients to Ripple's payments and digital asset services.

deal.rationale: enter corporate treasury and reach large corporate clients

moves.title: Fed's Waller floats 'skinny' master accounts for payment firms
moves.summary: Fed Governor Christopher Waller asked staff to explore a 'payment account' giving eligible institutions focused on payments basic access to Fed rails, with no interest, balance caps, no overdrafts and no discount window.

moves.title: Tesser raises $4.5m seed to give banks and PSPs stablecoin payments
moves.summary: New York-based Tesser, founded in 2025 by a former MoneyGram, Visa Direct and Circle executive, raised $4.5m led by Castle Island Ventures with Strobe Ventures and Anthemis for a full-stack stablecoin platform for licensed institutions.

round.use_of_funds: launching its platform for banks and PSPs

moves.title: Market maker B2C2 launches PENNY for zero-fee stablecoin swaps
moves.summary: Institutional liquidity provider B2C2 launched PENNY, a zero-fee platform for instant swaps between major stablecoins including USDT, USDC and PYUSD across several blockchains.

moves.title: Borderless.xyz launches an open benchmark for stablecoin FX rates
moves.summary: Borderless.xyz launched the Borderless Benchmark, an open reference for stablecoin-to-fiat exchange rates such as USDC, USDT and EURC against local currencies, built on its network of regulated on- and off-ramp providers.

moves.title: ESRB flags stablecoin risks and targets third-country multi-issuers
moves.summary: The European Systemic Risk Board published a report on crypto risks, focused on stablecoins, and issued a recommendation on stablecoins issued jointly by EU and non-EU entities, warning of vulnerabilities as crypto ties to finance grow.

moves.title: Modern Treasury buys stablecoin payments start-up Beam
moves.summary: Modern Treasury, valued at $2.1bn, acquired stablecoin and fiat payments platform Beam in an all-stock deal worth about $40m, a source told Fortune, to add stablecoin settlement to its payment operations software.

deal.rationale: stablecoin orchestration alongside traditional payment rails

moves.title: Switzerland proposes stablecoin and crypto institution licences
moves.summary: Switzerland's Federal Council opened a consultation, running to 6 February 2026, on new payment instrument institution licences covering stablecoins and crypto institution licences, under direct FINMA supervision.

moves.title: Zepz launches the Sendwave Wallet on USDC and Solana
moves.summary: Zepz, the remittance group behind WorldRemit and Sendwave, launched the Sendwave Wallet, putting stablecoins in users' hands with Circle's USDC, Solana and wallet provider Portal; Sendwave already serves over a million users.

moves.title: Blockchain.com wins MiCA licence from Malta's MFSA
moves.summary: Blockchain.com obtained a MiCA licence from the Malta Financial Services Authority, letting it offer institutional crypto products in 30 EEA countries as it expands in Europe.

moves.title: Toronto's Cybrid raises $10m Series A for stablecoin payment rails
moves.summary: Cybrid, a Toronto firm whose API combines stablecoin and fiat payments with compliance, raised a $10m Series A led by BDC Capital's Growth Venture Fund with Golden Ventures, Luge Capital and Panache Ventures.

round.use_of_funds: bringing stablecoin payments to more enterprises and Canadian financial institutions

moves.title: Fireblocks buys wallet developer platform Dynamic
moves.summary: Fireblocks acquired Dynamic, whose wallet and onboarding tools power over 50m on-chain accounts for firms including Kraken and zerohash, to offer a custody-to-consumer stack; Fortune later put the price at about $90m.

deal.rationale: a custody-to-consumer stack for fintechs and enterprises

moves.title: Pave Bank raises $39m led by Accel for programmable banking
moves.summary: Pave Bank, which joins traditional banking with regulated digital assets, raised $39m led by Accel with Tether Investments, Quona Capital, Wintermute and others, taking its total funding past $44m.

round.use_of_funds: global expansion, regulatory footprint and institutional banking infrastructure

moves.title: Revolut wins MiCA licence in Cyprus and adds 1:1 stablecoin swaps
moves.summary: Revolut received MiCA authorisation from Cyprus's CySEC to offer crypto services across 30 EEA markets, alongside new 1:1 conversions between US dollars and stablecoins and zero-fee staking.

moves.title: Transak taps Cross River for faster fiat rails in the US
moves.summary: Cross River Bank will process fiat payments for Transak, including ACH, wires and instant rails such as RTP and FedNow, to speed up settlement for the on-ramp's consumer and business users.

moves.title: Vantage Bank and Custodia offer tokenised deposits to US banks
moves.summary: Vantage Bank and Custodia invited US banks and credit unions to join a consortium offering tokenised deposits and stablecoins inside online banking. Tokens can switch between deposit and stablecoin status under oversight.

moves.title: USBC plans US Bank Coin tokenised deposit with Vast Bank and Uphold
moves.summary: NYSE-listed USBC unveiled US Bank Coin, a dollar tokenised deposit for retail users on a permissioned blockchain. Vast Bank will launch it first in 2026, with exchange Uphold distributing it to its users.

moves.title: Zelle's parent plans stablecoin-powered international transfers
moves.summary: Early Warning Services, which runs Zelle, said it will use stablecoins to let users send money across borders, citing clearer US rules after the GENIUS Act.

moves.title: Circle opens Arc public testnet with over 100 institutions
moves.summary: Circle deployed the public testnet of Arc, its blockchain with dollar-based fees and sub-second settlement, with over 100 financial and technology firms taking part, including BlackRock, Visa, HSBC and AWS.

moves.title: IBM launches Digital Asset Haven with Dfns for institutions
moves.summary: IBM announced Digital Asset Haven, built with wallet provider Dfns, for banks, governments and corporations to manage digital assets across more than 40 blockchains while meeting compliance obligations.

moves.title: Loon raises C$3m to take over the CADC Canadian-dollar stablecoin
moves.summary: Calgary-based Loon, spun out of Paytrie, raised C$3m in pre-seed funding led by Version One Ventures with Garage Capital and is acquiring Paytrie's CADC stablecoin, which moved over $200m on Base this year, to build it into a regulated token.

round.use_of_funds: a regulated Canadian-dollar stablecoin

moves.title: Western Union plans USDPT stablecoin on Solana with Anchorage
moves.summary: Western Union plans to roll out USDPT, a US dollar payment token issued by Anchorage Digital on Solana, for its payment network of 100m users in the first half of 2026.

moves.title: Italy's Bancomat plans EUR.bank, a euro stablecoin for 2026
moves.summary: Bancomat, the Italian payment network, unveiled EUR.bank, a euro stablecoin due in 2026 for cheap cross-border payments and the settlement of tokenised assets.

moves.title: FASB opens a project on accounting for stablecoins
moves.summary: The Financial Accounting Standards Board voted 6-1 to add stablecoin accounting to its technical agenda, after the President's digital asset working group asked it to consider treating stablecoins as cash equivalents.

moves.title: Hercle raises $10m led by F-Prime plus a $50m credit facility
moves.summary: Hercle, which gives payment providers and commodity traders stablecoin-based global money transfers and says it has processed over $20bn, raised a $10m equity round led by F-Prime and a $50m credit facility for expansion.

round.use_of_funds: global expansion

moves.title: Mastercard in late-stage talks to buy zerohash for up to $2bn
moves.summary: Mastercard was in late-stage talks to buy stablecoin infrastructure firm zerohash for $1.5bn to $2bn, Fortune reported; zerohash had raised $104m in September led by Interactive Brokers. Mastercard had earlier held talks with BVNK.

deal.rationale: stablecoin payments infrastructure

moves.title: Flutterwave picks Polygon for stablecoin payments across Africa
moves.summary: Flutterwave will use the Polygon network as the default rails for its new stablecoin payment system, starting with multinational clients such as Uber and Audiomack, across more than 30 African countries.

moves.title: Visa adds four stablecoins on four chains as card spend quadruples
moves.summary: Visa said it will support four more stablecoins across four blockchains, after spending through stablecoin-linked cards quadrupled year on year to over $2.5bn in annualised run rate.

moves.title: Coinbase in late-stage talks to buy BVNK for about $2bn
moves.summary: Coinbase was in late-stage talks to buy stablecoin infrastructure firm BVNK for about $2bn, Bloomberg reported, aiming to finish late in 2025 or early 2026; Coinbase Ventures was already a BVNK investor. Coinbase declined to comment.

deal.rationale: stablecoin payments infrastructure

moves.title: Cash App announces stablecoin support alongside bitcoin payments
moves.summary: Block's Cash App said it will add stablecoin support and let customers pay with bitcoin over Lightning without holding it, as part of its first bundled release of new features.

moves.title: Ripple buys wallet provider Palisade for its custody business
moves.summary: Ripple acquired Palisade, whose wallet-as-a-service platform joins Ripple Custody to give fintechs and corporates fast wallets for on- and off-ramps and payments. It was Ripple's fourth deal of 2025 after Hidden Road, Rail and GTreasury.

deal.rationale: fast wallet infrastructure for institutional custody and payments

moves.title: Ripple raises $500m at a $40bn valuation led by Fortress and Citadel
moves.summary: Ripple raised $500m in a strategic round led by Fortress Investment Group and Citadel Securities, with Pantera and Galaxy Digital, at a $40bn valuation, after a $1bn tender offer at the same price. Its payments platform has moved over $95bn.

moves.title: Arx Research raises $6.1m seed for its Burner stablecoin terminal
moves.summary: Arx Research raised a $6.1m seed round led by Castle Island Ventures with Inflection, Placeholder, Seed Club Ventures and 1kx to launch Burner Terminal, a point-of-sale device for stablecoin and card payments.

round.use_of_funds: launching its Burner Terminal point-of-sale device

moves.title: Tempo leads $25m round in blockchain infrastructure firm Commonware
moves.summary: Tempo, the payments blockchain launched by Stripe and Paradigm, led a $25m round in Commonware, which builds blockchain infrastructure for real-world payments. Other investors were not named.

moves.title: Paystand buys stablecoin payouts platform Bitwage
moves.summary: B2B payments network Paystand, which has processed over $20bn for more than 1,000 enterprises, acquired Bitwage to add stablecoin settlement, FX and international payroll to its platform.

deal.rationale: stablecoin settlement and payouts for enterprise customers

moves.title: Bank of England consults on rules for systemic sterling stablecoins
moves.summary: The Bank of England published a consultation paper setting out its proposed regime for sterling-denominated systemic stablecoins.

moves.summary: London-based ClearToken won FCA authorisation to launch CT Settle, a delivery-versus-payment system for crypto, stablecoins and fiat that removes pre-funding, modelled on CLS in foreign exchange.

moves.title: J.P. Morgan's Kinexys and DBS link up on tokenised deposit transfers
moves.summary: Kinexys by J.P. Morgan and DBS plan an interoperability framework linking their blockchains so tokenised deposits can move between the banks around the clock for cross-border settlement.

moves.title: Standard Chartered backs DCS's DeCard stablecoin credit card
moves.summary: Standard Chartered became principal banking partner for DeCard, DCS Card Centre's credit card for spending stablecoins, providing transaction banking and financial markets services in Singapore.

moves.title: Transak adds six US state money transmitter licences
moves.summary: Transak secured money transmitter licences in Iowa, Kansas, Michigan, South Carolina, Vermont and Pennsylvania, widening its regulated reach for stablecoin payments in the US.

moves.title: UAE completes its first government payment in Digital Dirham
moves.summary: The UAE's Ministry of Finance and Dubai Finance made the first government transaction in the Digital Dirham, the central bank's digital currency, in under two minutes, as the country readies rules for stablecoins and digital money.

moves.title: Sui launches native stablecoin USDsui issued by Bridge
moves.summary: The Sui blockchain unveiled USDsui, a native dollar stablecoin issued by Stripe's Bridge and designed to meet the GENIUS Act.

moves.title: Monerium links its euro stablecoin to Finery Markets' liquidity
moves.summary: Monerium integrated with Finery Markets so its EURe euro stablecoin can tap institutional liquidity and cross rates with USDC and USDT.

moves.title: Rain buys on-chain rewards platform Uptop
moves.summary: Stablecoin card platform Rain acquired Uptop, which turns card spending into loyalty rewards for brands and sports teams, so partners can issue branded cards and wallets with built-in rewards.

deal.rationale: rewards inside branded card and wallet programmes

moves.title: Nebraska issues first digital asset bank charter to Telcoin
moves.summary: Nebraska's governor and banking regulator issued a charter to Telcoin Digital Asset Bank under the state's Financial Innovation Act, letting it run a stablecoin and digital asset business.

moves.title: Thunes launches account top-ups and withdrawals for crypto platforms
moves.summary: Thunes launched account top-up and withdrawal services so major digital asset platforms can run on- and off-ramp transactions through its network, backed by its compliance and treasury systems.

moves.title: BNY launches a reserve fund for stablecoin issuers
moves.summary: BNY launched a regulated money market fund for stablecoin issuers to hold reserves under US rules, with Anchorage Digital providing the initial investment.

moves.title: Cardano Foundation partners with Brale on compliant stablecoins
moves.summary: The Cardano Foundation partnered with stablecoin issuance platform Brale to bring compliant stablecoin tools to builders and enterprises on Cardano.

moves.summary: Circle announced StableFX, an institutional stablecoin FX engine on Arc's public testnet, and Circle Partner Stablecoins, a programme for local-currency stablecoins issued by partners, to move FX settlement on-chain.

moves.title: FDIC prepares guidance on deposit insurance for tokenised deposits
moves.summary: The FDIC's chair confirmed the agency is drafting guidance on how deposit insurance applies to tokenised deposits, to help banks that issue them on blockchains.

moves.title: Hercle and Lightspark add instant bitcoin payouts in euros and pounds
moves.summary: Hercle became the first partner of Lightspark Grid in Europe, offering payment firms, fintechs and institutions instant settlement from bitcoin into euros and British pounds across the EU and the UK.

moves.title: Mastercard Move adds stablecoin wallet payouts through Thunes
moves.summary: Mastercard and Thunes announced at the Singapore Fintech Festival that Mastercard Move will make near real-time payouts to stablecoin wallets through Thunes' Direct Global Network.

moves.title: Citi and Swift complete fiat-to-digital currency settlement trial
moves.summary: Citi and Swift completed a trial showing that payments can settle between fiat and digital currencies through synchronised settlement, using Swift messaging to bridge the two.

moves.title: Mastercard and Circle bring USDC and EURC settlement to EEMEA
moves.summary: Mastercard introduced its first stablecoin settlement capability in Eastern Europe, the Middle East and Africa with Circle, letting acquirers and issuers in the region settle card transactions in USDC and EURC.

moves.title: Alibaba to settle B2B payments with J.P. Morgan tokenised deposits
moves.summary: Alibaba's global business-to-business platform will use J.P. Morgan's blockchain and tokenised dollar and euro deposits to speed up cross-border payments, CNBC reported.

moves.title: MoonPay launches an enterprise stablecoin business built on M0
moves.summary: MoonPay launched a business that issues and manages fully reserved stablecoins for enterprises across several blockchains, integrating M0's issuance infrastructure and distributing the tokens through its global network.

moves.title: Obex raises $37m to incubate stablecoins backed by real-world credit
moves.summary: Obex, an incubator for stablecoins backed by compute, energy and fintech credit, raised $37m led by Framework Ventures and Sky, which has committed up to $2.5bn to the projects it backs.

round.use_of_funds: funding new asset-backed stablecoin projects

moves.title: Riyadh's Palm Azgar launches PUSD, backed by dirham and riyal reserves
moves.summary: Palm Azgar Finance Company, a licensed provider in Riyadh, launched PUSD through its British Virgin Islands affiliate, a dollar stablecoin whose reserves are held in UAE dirhams and Saudi riyals at Shariah-compliant institutions.

moves.title: Circle launches xReserve for USDC-backed stablecoins on other chains
moves.summary: Circle launched xReserve, infrastructure that lets developers deploy stablecoins fully backed by USDC reserves with 1:1 interoperability across blockchains.

moves.title: HSBC plans wider tokenised deposit service for the first half of 2026
moves.summary: HSBC is due to expand its tokenised deposit service, already offered in Hong Kong, Singapore and other markets, with the launch scheduled for the first half of 2026, PYMNTS reported.

moves.title: French on-chain bank Deblock raises €30m Series A
moves.summary: Deblock, a French app combining a current account with self-custodial crypto, raised a €30m Series A led by Speedinvest with Commerz Ventures and Latitude, to expand into Germany.

round.use_of_funds: expansion into Germany and across Europe

moves.title: Exodus agrees to buy W3C, parent of card firms Baanx and Monavate
moves.summary: Wallet company Exodus agreed to buy W3C Corp, parent of Baanx and Monavate, gaining card issuing and processing to issue cards on Visa, Mastercard and Discover in the US, UK and EU with stablecoin support. Terms were not disclosed.

deal.rationale: card issuing and processing for its wallet users

moves.title: Cross River adds stablecoin payments to its real-time core system
moves.summary: Cross River Bank launched a stablecoin payments offering built into COS, its real-time core system, unifying fiat and stablecoin flows within a single platform.

moves.title: Klarna launches KlarnaUSD, the first bank-issued token on Tempo
moves.summary: Klarna launched KlarnaUSD, its first stablecoin and the first bank-issued token on Tempo, the payments blockchain built by Stripe and Paradigm, to cut the cost of cross-border payments.

moves.title: MoonPay wins a New York trust charter on top of its BitLicense
moves.summary: MoonPay received a New York limited purpose trust charter from NYDFS, letting its new trust company offer crypto custody and OTC trading; it now holds both a BitLicense and a trust charter.

moves.title: U.S. Bank pilots its own stablecoin issuance on Stellar
moves.summary: U.S. Bancorp, the fifth-largest US commercial bank, is testing custom stablecoin issuance on the Stellar network, including features such as asset freezing and transaction reversal that suit compliance needs.

moves.title: FCA opens a stablecoin cohort in its Regulatory Sandbox
moves.summary: The FCA launched a stablecoin cohort in its Regulatory Sandbox so issuers can test products under the UK's coming regime and help shape its rules.

moves.title: Polygon partners with Stableport on B2B stablecoin payments
moves.summary: Polygon partnered with Stableport to run business-to-business stablecoin payment flows on Polygon PoS through Stableport's network of licensed virtual asset service providers.

moves.title: Lead Bank brings in stablecoin payments start-up Loop Crypto
moves.summary: Loop Crypto's team joined Lead Bank, which said their expertise strengthens the regulated, programmable banking it offers to payment companies building on stablecoins.

deal.rationale: stablecoin payments expertise

moves.title: Rain buys Fern for on- and off-ramp routing across chains
moves.summary: Rain acquired Fern and its multiplex, a routing, orchestration and compliance engine that connects liquidity providers and bank partners to pick the best path for converting assets across chains.

deal.rationale: reliable on- and off-ramps across chains

moves.title: UK law recognises crypto and stablecoins as personal property
moves.summary: The Property (Digital Assets etc) Act received Royal Assent, confirming digital assets can be owned, recovered after theft or fraud, and included in insolvency and estates.

moves.title: Unlimit launches Stable.com, a clearing house for stablecoins
moves.summary: Payments firm Unlimit, founded in 2009, launched Stable.com, a non-custodial clearing house that combines swaps between major stablecoins with fiat off-ramps worldwide.

moves.title: Navro adds stablecoin payouts through BVNK
moves.summary: Navro, which handles international payments for businesses, added stablecoin payments to its rails through BVNK so clients can pay customers, contractors and staff abroad.

moves.title: Coinbase says it runs stablecoin pilots with large US banks
moves.summary: Coinbase is running pilot programmes with some of the largest US banks covering stablecoins, crypto custody and trading, its chief executive said at the New York Times DealBook Summit.

moves.title: Fin, formerly TipLink, raises $17m led by Pantera
moves.summary: Fin, a stablecoin app for sending large sums across borders, raised $17m led by Pantera Capital with Sequoia and Samsung Next.

moves.title: OpenPayd powers Altify's euro, sterling and dollar on- and off-ramps
moves.summary: Tokenised private markets app Altify partnered with OpenPayd to handle fiat deposits and withdrawals in EUR, GBP and USD for its more than 80,000 users.

moves.title: 1Money launches a zero-fee stablecoin orchestration platform
moves.summary: 1Money launched 1Money.com, a stablecoin orchestration platform with no platform fees, self-onboarding and gasless transactions on its own network, pitched as a cheaper alternative to Bridge and BVNK.

moves.title: BNY, Nasdaq, S&P Global and iCapital invest $50m in Digital Asset
moves.summary: Digital Asset, the company behind the Canton Network, took a $50m strategic investment from BNY, iCapital, Nasdaq and S&P Global as traditional finance backs regulated blockchain infrastructure.

round.use_of_funds: building out the Canton Network with the investors

moves.title: Dubai Customs signs MoU with Binance on crypto payments for trade
moves.summary: Dubai Customs signed a memorandum of understanding with Binance FZE to bring Binance Pay and other crypto payment services into customs, trade and logistics, aiming to cut costs and clearance times for SMEs.

moves.title: Kraken launches Kraken Ramp, a single API for crypto on-ramps
moves.summary: Kraken launched Kraken Ramp, a unified fiat-to-crypto API that lets platforms offer crypto access on Kraken's licensed rails and liquidity, with Kraken handling compliance, KYC and fraud checks behind the scenes.

moves.title: Brale's SBC stablecoin funds tokenised Treasury repo on Canton
moves.summary: Brale-issued stablecoin SBC served as a funding leg in coordinated tokenised US Treasury repo trades on the Canton Network, as more institutions joined the working group behind them.

moves.title: Tempo opens its public testnet with Mastercard, UBS and Kalshi
moves.summary: Tempo, the payments blockchain built by Stripe and Paradigm, launched its public testnet and added partners including Kalshi, Mastercard and UBS.

moves.summary: Stripe acqui-hired the team behind Valora, a Celo-based crypto payments app, while its intellectual property returned to cLabs; it adds to Stripe's purchases of Bridge and Privy and its work on Tempo.

deal.rationale: stablecoin payments talent

moves.title: Anchorage Digital to issue OSL's USDGO stablecoin
moves.summary: Anchorage Digital will be the federally regulated US issuer of USDGO, the dollar stablecoin branded by Hong Kong-listed OSL Group.

moves.title: Klarna works with Privy on crypto wallets for its users
moves.summary: Klarna partnered with Stripe-owned Privy to develop crypto wallet features for its users, building on the launch of KlarnaUSD, its dollar stablecoin.

moves.title: World App rolls out Bridge-powered accounts for USDC payroll
moves.summary: World App's virtual accounts, powered by Stripe's Bridge, let users receive payroll and deposits directly in USDC, and expanded from the US to Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan and Latin America.

moves.title: Singapore Gulf Bank launches zero-fee stablecoin minting on Solana
moves.summary: Singapore Gulf Bank let corporate clients mint and redeem USDC and USDT on Solana, waiving transaction and gas fees for a launch period; it says it has processed over $7bn across Asia and the GCC corridor.

moves.title: YouTube pays US creators in PYUSD through PayPal
moves.summary: YouTube began offering US creators payouts in PayPal's PYUSD stablecoin, with PayPal handling the crypto side so the platform does not touch it directly.

moves.title: Volt adds stablecoin acceptance to its checkout through BVNK
moves.summary: Volt, the real-time payments platform, partnered with BVNK to offer stablecoin pay-ins at checkout to its merchants, the first phase of a wider collaboration.

moves.title: Circle agrees to buy Interop Labs' team and technology
moves.summary: Circle signed an agreement to acquire the team and proprietary technology of Interop Labs, core contributors to the Axelar Network, to strengthen its cross-chain work; the deal was expected to close in early 2026.

deal.rationale: cross-chain interoperability

moves.title: PayPal applies for a Utah industrial bank licence
moves.summary: PayPal, the issuer of PYUSD, applied for a Utah industrial bank licence to create PayPal Bank, which would offer business lending and interest-bearing savings accounts.

moves.title: UK lays final law for its crypto regime, including stablecoin issuance
moves.summary: HM Treasury laid the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (Cryptoassets) Regulations 2025, creating regulated activities such as running a crypto trading platform and issuing stablecoins.

moves.title: Visa launches a Stablecoins Advisory Practice for banks and fintechs
moves.summary: Visa launched a consulting service to help banks, fintechs and merchants plan stablecoin strategies, with early clients including Wirex, Pathward, VyStar and Navy Federal Credit Union.

moves.title: Exodus plans a dollar stablecoin issued with MoonPay
moves.summary: Listed crypto wallet firm Exodus said it will launch a fully reserved dollar stablecoin with MoonPay to power self-custodial payments in its wallet app.

moves.title: RedotPay raises $107m Series B led by Goodwater
moves.summary: Hong Kong-based RedotPay, which runs stablecoin cards and cross-border payouts in 100+ countries, raised $107m led by Goodwater Capital with Pantera, Blockchain Capital and Circle Ventures, taking its 2025 total to $194m.

round.use_of_funds: global expansion of stablecoin payments

moves.title: Tether leads $8m round in Lightning and USDT payments firm Speed
moves.summary: Tether co-led an $8m round with ego death capital in Speed, whose wallet and merchant products settle in bitcoin over Lightning and in USDT for 1.2m users and businesses, handling over $1.5bn a year.

round.use_of_funds: USDT settlement for payments

moves.title: SoFi launches SoFiUSD, the first stablecoin from a US national bank
moves.summary: SoFi Bank launched SoFiUSD, a dollar stablecoin backed 1:1 by cash held at the Federal Reserve, for banks, fintechs and enterprises to settle payments.

moves.title: Klarna raises short-term funding in USDC through Coinbase
moves.summary: Klarna partnered with Coinbase to raise short-term funding from institutional investors in USDC, adding stablecoins to a funding mix of deposits, loans and commercial paper.

moves.title: Fed seeks comment on 'payment accounts' with basic access to its rails
moves.summary: The Federal Reserve opened a 45-day request for information on prototype payment accounts for eligible institutions, without access to Fed credit; Governor Barr opposed it over money-laundering safeguards.

moves.title: Coinbax raises $4.2m seed for controls on stablecoin payments
moves.summary: Coinbax, which adds programmable escrow and controls to stablecoin payments for banks and credit unions, raised a $4.2m seed led by BankTech Ventures with Connecticut Innovations, Paxos and SpringTime Ventures.

round.use_of_funds: engineering, integrations and onboarding design partners

moves.title: Shift4 launches stablecoin settlement for merchants worldwide
moves.summary: Payments processor Shift4 launched a global stablecoin settlement platform that lets merchants receive their funds in stablecoins at any time, faster than through banking rails.

moves.title: Standard Chartered launches tokenised deposits with Ant International
moves.summary: Standard Chartered launched a tokenised deposit service in Singapore dollars and US dollars for 24/7 treasury management, with Ant International as its first client.

moves.title: Bank start-up Erebor raises $350m at $4.35bn valuation
moves.summary: Erebor, the Columbus-based digital bank co-founded by Palmer Luckey that calls itself stablecoin-native, closed a $350m round valuing it at $4.35bn, Axios reported, weeks after conditional OCC approval.

round.use_of_funds: building a bank for technology, AI and defence companies

moves.title: London's Nodu raises $1.45m for a stablecoin layer for banks
moves.summary: Nodu, founded in London in 2025 by the team behind Crassula, raised $1.45m pre-seed led by Digital Space Ventures for a plug-in layer that lets banks and licensed fintechs send, receive and hold stablecoins with compliance automated.

round.use_of_funds: European expansion, hiring and partnerships with regulated institutions

moves.title: Rain raises $250m Series C led by ICONIQ at a $1.95bn valuation
moves.summary: Stablecoin card and payments platform Rain raised $250m led by ICONIQ, valuing it at $1.95bn, more than 17 times its value ten months earlier, and taking its total funding past $338m.

round.use_of_funds: new markets and platform capabilities

moves.title: Fireblocks buys crypto accounting platform TRES for about $130m
moves.summary: Fireblocks agreed to buy TRES Finance, a crypto accounting, reconciliation and reporting platform, for cash and equity worth about $130m, its second deal after buying wallet platform Dynamic for around $90m in October.

deal.rationale: accounting, reconciliation and audit-ready reporting

moves.title: J.P. Morgan to issue its JPM Coin deposit token natively on Canton
moves.summary: Kinexys by J.P. Morgan and Digital Asset plan to issue JPMD, the bank's dollar deposit token, natively on the Canton Network for 24/7 settlement, in a phased 2026 rollout after its launch on Base.

moves.title: Barclays invests in stablecoin clearing firm Ubyx
moves.summary: Barclays made an undisclosed investment in Ubyx, which builds clearing for tokenised money such as bank deposits and regulated stablecoins, as UBS, PostFinance and Sygnum also explore regulated on-chain payments.

moves.title: World Liberty Financial applies to the OCC for a trust bank
moves.summary: World Liberty Financial applied to the OCC to launch World Liberty Trust Company, a national trust bank that would issue its USD1 stablecoin directly.

moves.title: BVNK wins direct SEPA access for instant euro payments
moves.summary: BVNK became a direct participant in SEPA through the Bank of Lithuania's CENTROlink, with its own accounts on SEPA Credit Transfer and SEPA Instant, so it can offer euro and stablecoin payments 24/7 without partner banks.

moves.title: BNY goes live with tokenised deposits for collateral and margin
moves.summary: BNY launched tokenised deposits for collateral and margin payments, with firms including Anchorage Digital, Paxos, Galaxy, Ripple Prime, Securitize, Talos and zerohash involved.

moves.title: VelaFi raises $20m Series B for enterprise stablecoin payments
moves.summary: VelaFi, a Latin America-based provider of stablecoin payment and treasury infrastructure for enterprises, raised a $20m Series B led by XVC and Ikuyo, taking its total past $40m, to expand in the US and Asia.

round.use_of_funds: expansion across the US and Asia

moves.title: Franklin Templeton adapts a money market fund for stablecoin reserves
moves.summary: Franklin Templeton modified its institutional LUIXX money market fund to hold short-term Treasuries and meet stablecoin reserve standards, and gave its DIGXX fund an on-chain share class.

moves.title: Ingenico brings stablecoin payments to physical checkouts
moves.summary: Ingenico, the payment terminal maker, partnered with WalletConnect Pay so merchants can accept supported stablecoins directly at checkout.

moves.title: Noah and NALA build instant stablecoin settlement for Africa and Asia
moves.summary: Noah and NALA partnered so businesses in Africa and Asia can collect US dollars anywhere and pay out local currency in minutes, pairing Noah's USD collection with NALA's licensed stablecoin on- and off-ramp network.

moves.title: Polygon Labs agrees to buy Coinme and Sequence for over $250m
moves.summary: Polygon Labs signed deals to buy Coinme, whose money transmitter licences cover 48 US states with 50,000 retail cash points, and wallet firm Sequence for more than $250m, to build its Open Money Stack for regulated US stablecoin payments.

deal.rationale: regulated US stablecoin payments for the Open Money Stack

moves.title: Meld raises $7m to link stablecoin on- and off-ramp networks
moves.summary: Meld, a network joining 50+ crypto payment providers in 180+ countries, founded by a Block veteran, raised $7m led by Lightspeed Faction with F-Prime, Yolo Investments and Scytale Digital, taking its total to $15m.

moves.title: Senate Banking Committee cancels its crypto market structure markup
moves.summary: The Senate Banking Committee called off its planned vote on the crypto market structure bill as negotiations, including over stablecoin rewards, ran out of time.

moves.title: Gusto taps zerohash for stablecoin payouts to workers abroad
moves.summary: Payroll and HR platform Gusto partnered with zerohash to offer workers outside the US near-instant payouts in stablecoins, to custodial or self-custodial wallets.

moves.title: Interactive Brokers takes USDC deposits around the clock via zerohash
moves.summary: Eligible Interactive Brokers clients can deposit USDC at any time, converted to dollars within minutes, with Ripple's RLUSD to follow; the service runs on zerohash.

moves.title: WSPN partners with HIFI on stablecoin-fiat conversion
moves.summary: Worldwide Stablecoin Payment Network (WSPN) partnered with licensed payments infrastructure provider HIFI so institutional clients can convert between stablecoins and fiat for cross-border payments.

moves.title: zerohash walks away from Mastercard takeover to stay independent
moves.summary: zerohash ended takeover talks with Mastercard, reported in October at $1.5bn to $2bn, saying it was "not entertaining an acquisition"; Mastercard was said to be weighing a strategic investment instead.

deal.rationale: zerohash chose to remain independent

moves.title: BitGo lists on the NYSE after a $213m IPO at $18 a share
moves.summary: Crypto custodian BitGo priced its IPO at $18 a share, above its $15 to $17 range, raising $213m at a valuation above $2bn; the shares opened at $22.43 on the NYSE. It was last valued at $1.75bn in a 2023 Series C.

moves.title: Capital One agrees to buy Brex for $5.15bn
moves.summary: Capital One agreed to acquire Brex, the corporate card and spend platform that added stablecoin payments in 2025, for $5.15bn split evenly between cash and stock, expanding its business payments strategy.

deal.rationale: business payments technology and clients

moves.title: zerohash in talks to raise $250m at a $1.5bn valuation
moves.summary: After walking away from Mastercard's takeover approach to stay independent, zerohash was in talks to raise $250m at a $1.5bn valuation, according to a source cited by CoinDesk; Mastercard was said to be weighing an investment.

moves.title: Y Combinator lets start-ups take its $500,000 investment in USDC
moves.summary: Y Combinator said founders in its Spring 2026 batch can receive the standard $500,000 investment in USDC across major blockchains instead of dollars.

moves.title: BBVA joins the Qivalis bank consortium for a euro stablecoin
moves.summary: BBVA joined Qivalis, the banking consortium developing a regulated euro stablecoin for faster, cheaper payments and the settlement of digital assets.

moves.title: Tether said to cut its raise to about $5bn; its CEO disputes it
moves.summary: The FT reported Tether's advisers were discussing a raise of about $5bn, down from up to $20bn, after investors balked at a $500bn valuation. CEO Paolo Ardoino said the larger figures were a maximum, not a target.

moves.title: UK Parliament passes rules bringing stablecoin issuance under FSMA
moves.summary: Parliament passed the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (Cryptoassets) Regulations 2026, bringing crypto dealing, custody, stablecoin issuance and staking arrangements within the UK regulatory perimeter for the first time.

moves.title: Fiserv's Clover merchants can take crypto through the Lydian app
moves.summary: A Lydian app lets merchants on Fiserv's Clover point-of-sale accept payment in over 300 digital assets, including USDT, while settling in local fiat currency.

moves.title: Superset raises $4m seed for stablecoin and on-chain FX liquidity
moves.summary: Superset, building a shared liquidity layer for stablecoins, tokenised deposits and on-chain FX, raised $4m from 7RIDGE and Exponential Science Capital; ClearBank co-founder Charles McManus joined as chairman and investor.

moves.title: Agant registers with the FCA ahead of GBPA sterling stablecoin
moves.summary: Stablecoin issuer Agant won FCA registration as a cryptoasset business under money laundering rules, clearing the way to issue GBPA, a fully backed sterling stablecoin for institutional use.

moves.title: Modern Treasury adds stablecoin settlement to its payments platform
moves.summary: Modern Treasury launched a payments platform that settles in USDG, USDP and USDC alongside ACH, wires and real-time rails, after buying Beam and partnering with Paxos; USDT is to follow.

moves.title: World Liberty brings USD1 into Apex Group's fund services
moves.summary: World Liberty Financial and Apex Group, a fund services firm in 52 countries, agreed to integrate the USD1 stablecoin for subscriptions, distributions and redemptions of tokenised assets.

moves.title: Anchorage launches stablecoin services for international banks
moves.summary: Anchorage Digital launched Stablecoin Solutions for Banks, giving licensed international banks federally regulated stablecoin issuance, custody and US dollar settlement to modernise cross-border payments.

moves.title: SG-FORGE brings its euro stablecoin to the XRP Ledger
moves.summary: Société Générale's digital assets unit launched EUR CoinVertible on the XRP Ledger, its third blockchain after Ethereum and Solana, with about €65.8m in circulation.

moves.title: Crypto.com wins conditional OCC approval for a national trust bank
moves.summary: Crypto.com received conditional OCC approval to set up Foris DAX National Trust Bank, consolidating its US custody services under federal oversight.

moves.title: Stablecore joins Jack Henry's network to reach 1,600 banks
moves.summary: Stablecore joined the Jack Henry Fintech Integration Network so banks and credit unions on its cores can offer stablecoin accounts, tokenised deposits and digital asset services.

moves.title: Meta plans stablecoin payments in the second half of 2026
moves.summary: Meta sent a request for proposals to third parties to help run stablecoin payments and plans a new wallet, with a launch aimed at the second half of the year, sources told CoinDesk.

moves.title: MoonPay launches MoonPay Agents, money tools for AI agents
moves.summary: MoonPay launched MoonPay Agents, non-custodial infrastructure that lets AI agents fund themselves, pay and off-ramp back to fiat.

moves.title: Payoneer applies to the OCC to open a stablecoin-focused bank

moves.title: RedotPay said to prepare a New York IPO of over $1bn
moves.summary: Hong Kong-based stablecoin payments firm RedotPay is preparing a US listing that could raise more than $1bn, and has hired JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs and Jefferies, Bloomberg reported. No deal has been announced.

round.use_of_funds: a US initial public offering

moves.title: Stable Sea and dLocal partner on B2B stablecoin payments
moves.summary: Stable Sea partnered with dLocal to use dLocal's local payment rails in more than 40 countries for its business stablecoin payouts and settlement.

moves.summary: Bloomberg reported that Stripe, valued at $159bn and owner of Bridge, was considering buying all or parts of PayPal, issuer of the PYUSD stablecoin through Paxos; PayPal shares rose 7%.

moves.title: FCA picks four firms to test stablecoins in its sandbox
moves.summary: The FCA chose Monee Financial Technologies, ReStabilise, Revolut and VVTX from 20 applicants to test stablecoin services against its proposed rules in the Regulatory Sandbox.

moves.title: Morgan Stanley applies for a national trust bank for digital assets
moves.summary: Morgan Stanley applied to the OCC for a national trust bank charter for a standalone digital asset entity, as it prepares spot crypto trading for E*Trade clients with zerohash.

moves.title: Crossmint supports Western Union's USDPT stablecoin on Solana
moves.summary: Crossmint partnered with Western Union to support USDPT, its new dollar stablecoin on Solana, and the Digital Asset Network that links digital dollars to over 360,000 cash payout points.

moves.title: Kraken becomes the first crypto firm with a Fed master account
moves.summary: Kraken Financial received approval for a Federal Reserve master account, speeding deposits and withdrawals for large clients, though it cannot earn interest on reserves or use emergency lending.

moves.title: Tether invests in treasury and settlement firm Axiym
moves.summary: Tether made a strategic investment in Axiym, which builds treasury and settlement infrastructure inside regulated payment networks, including pay-now-settle-later, so payment firms can use USDT where their dollars already sit.

round.use_of_funds: USDT flows inside regulated payment ecosystems

moves.title: KAST raises $80m at a $600m valuation for its stablecoin neobank
moves.summary: KAST, an 18-month-old stablecoin payments app with a claimed 1 million users, raised an $80m Series A at a $600m valuation and targets $100m in annual revenue.

round.use_of_funds: growing its stablecoin accounts and cards

moves.title: SquareFi emerges with stablecoin infrastructure for B2B payments
moves.summary: SquareFi came out of stealth with stablecoin-based infrastructure for global business payments, already serving fintechs and platforms with $250m in transaction volume.
