moves.summary: MoonPay launched the Open Wallet Standard, an open-source standard for AI agents to hold and move money, with contributions from PayPal, Ripple, Circle, Polygon and others.

moves.title: Deloitte Canada and Stablecorp build QCAD rails for banks
moves.summary: Deloitte Canada and Stablecorp formed an alliance to deliver QCAD-based stablecoin infrastructure to Canadian financial institutions.

moves.title: BMO launches tokenised cash and deposits with CME and Google Cloud
moves.summary: BMO became the first bank to offer CME Group's tokenised cash on Google Cloud's Universal Ledger, letting clients move funds 24/7 for margin calls, trading and settlement.

moves.title: Monument Bank to tokenise up to £250m of retail deposits
moves.summary: UK challenger Monument Bank plans to tokenise up to £250m of retail deposits on the Midnight blockchain, keeping them interest-bearing, fully backed and covered by the FSCS.

moves.title: Payy raises $6m seed for private stablecoin payments
moves.summary: New York-based Payy, building a zero-knowledge network and wallet that keep USDC payments private, announced a $6m seed led by FirstMark Capital, taking its total to $8m; it has over 100,000 users.

round.use_of_funds: mainnet launch and enterprise payments

moves.title: Circle Ventures leads Tazapay's Series B extension, total $36m
moves.summary: Circle Ventures led an extension that took Tazapay's Series B to $36m, with new investors CMT Digital and Coinbase Ventures and Ripple among existing backers, to widen corridors across Asia, Latin America and the Middle East.

round.use_of_funds: cross-border corridors across Asia, Latin America and the Middle East

moves.title: Miami's XFX raises $17m Series A for fiat and stablecoin FX
moves.summary: Miami-based XFX, which builds foreign exchange and payment infrastructure for moving between cash and stablecoins, raised $17m led by Castle Island Ventures with Haun Ventures and Coinbase Ventures, after a $9m seed.

moves.summary: Wirex expanded its work with Crossmint: Wirex handles card issuance, bank accounts and payment rails while Crossmint provides wallets and stablecoin orchestration.

moves.title: Better Money raises $10m seed for a stablecoin clearinghouse
moves.summary: The Better Money Company, founded by former a16z crypto investor Sam Broner, raised a $10m seed led by a16z crypto with BoxGroup and Sunflower Capital to build a clearinghouse where firms can cheaply exchange different dollar stablecoins.

round.use_of_funds: a stablecoin clearinghouse

moves.title: Latitude raises $8m led by NEA for stablecoin global payouts
moves.summary: Latitude, founded by former Stripe and Coinbase staff and offering stablecoin-based global payouts, raised $8m led by NEA with Lightspeed Faction, Coinbase, Paxos and the Solana Foundation.

moves.title: OpenFX raises $94m for stablecoin-powered cross-border FX
moves.summary: OpenFX, founded in 2024 to move large cross-border sums using stablecoins and handling over $45bn of annualised volume, raised $94m led by Accel, Lightspeed Faction, M13, Northzone and Pantera, at about a $500m valuation per Reuters.

round.use_of_funds: expansion into Southeast Asia and Latin America

moves.title: Merge launches named euro IBANs for fiat-stablecoin payments
moves.summary: Merge, a regulated fintech backed by Octopus Ventures and Coinbase, launched named EUR IBANs so businesses can give their users dedicated euro accounts for collection, reconciliation and payouts.

moves.title: Rain and Episode Six expand stablecoin cards in Asia-Pacific
moves.summary: Rain partnered with card processor Episode Six to power stablecoin credit, debit and prepaid card programmes for enterprise clients across Asia-Pacific.

moves.title: BitGo launches BitGo Mint for institutional stablecoin issuance
moves.summary: BitGo launched BitGo Mint so institutional clients can mint, redeem and manage stablecoins from one interface alongside its custody, starting with SoFiUSD and USD1.

moves.title: Kulipa raises $6.2m seed for stablecoin card issuing
moves.summary: Kulipa, which provides stablecoin card issuing infrastructure to fintechs, raised a $6.2m seed co-led by Flourish Ventures and 1kx to expand regulated issuing in Europe, Latin America and Africa.

round.use_of_funds: regulated card issuing in more regions

moves.title: Tether gives investors two weeks to commit at a $500bn valuation
moves.summary: Tether will likely postpone its fundraising if too few investors commit within two weeks, The Information reported. It has been raising since late 2025 but met investor concerns about the $500bn valuation it is seeking.

moves.title: Polygon Labs seeks up to $100m for its stablecoin payments business
moves.summary: Polygon Labs is in the early stages of raising $50m to $100m in equity to build out its Open Money Stack stablecoin payments business, The Information reported. No round has been announced.

round.use_of_funds: the Open Money Stack payments platform

moves.title: UBS and five Swiss banks launch a joint Swiss franc stablecoin sandbox
moves.summary: UBS, PostFinance, Sygnum, Raiffeisen, Zürcher Kantonalbank, BCV and Swiss Stablecoin AG launched a sandbox to test uses for a Swiss franc stablecoin and connect blockchain applications with the franc.

moves.title: Hong Kong grants first stablecoin licences to HSBC and Anchorpoint
moves.summary: The HKMA issued Hong Kong's first stablecoin issuer licences under its Stablecoins Ordinance to HSBC and Anchorpoint Financial, the Standard Chartered-led venture, effective 10 April.

moves.title: Deutsche Börse buys 1.5% of Kraken for $200m
moves.summary: Deutsche Börse took a 1.5% stake in Kraken for $200m, deepening a partnership begun in December to bridge traditional and digital markets for institutions in Europe.

round.use_of_funds: a strategic stake alongside the two firms' partnership

moves.title: eToro agrees to buy self-custody wallet Zengo for about $70m
moves.summary: Trading platform eToro agreed to acquire crypto wallet Zengo in a deal estimated at around $70m, moving into self-custody with wallet technology meant to protect users' assets.

deal.rationale: self-custodial wallet technology for its users

moves.title: Tether joins $134m raise for Stablecoin Development Corporation
moves.summary: Tether Investments took part in a $134m financing for Stablecoin Development Corporation, an NYSE American-listed firm offering public-market access to the stablecoin economy, alongside R01 Fund and Framework Ventures.

moves.title: SG-FORGE brings its USD CoinVertible stablecoin to MetaMask
moves.summary: Société Générale-FORGE partnered with Consensys to make its USD CoinVertible stablecoin available to MetaMask's millions of users.

moves.title: Bastion applies to turn its New York trust into a national trust bank
moves.summary: Bastion applied to the OCC to convert its New York limited purpose trust charter into Bastion Platforms National Trust Company; an adviser said a national charter removes much of the complexity of white-label stablecoins nationwide.

moves.title: Crossmint's Lobster.cash plugs AI agents into Mastercard Agent Pay
moves.summary: Crossmint's Lobster.cash integrated Mastercard Agent Pay so AI agents in the Openclaw ecosystem can pay with users' existing Mastercard cards under issuer controls.

moves.title: MoneyGram and NALA partner on stablecoin-settled payouts
moves.summary: MoneyGram and NALA, a stablecoin payments company, partnered to power cross-border payouts into emerging markets with stablecoin settlement.

moves.title: Meow adds stablecoin payments for business customers through BVNK
moves.summary: Meow, a business banking fintech for global teams and AI agents backed by Tiger Global and QED, partnered with BVNK to power stablecoin and crypto payments for its customers.

moves.title: Tether leads $8m round in Abu Dhabi tokenisation firm KAIO
moves.summary: Abu Dhabi-headquartered KAIO, which tokenises institutional funds from managers such as BlackRock and Hamilton Lane, raised $8m led by Tether, taking its total to $19m, and plans an on-chain fund with Mubadala Capital.

moves.title: Nium adds USDC payments for its clients through Coinbase
moves.summary: Nium made USDC payouts, treasury and card programmes live for its clients, with Coinbase as stablecoin payments and liquidity infrastructure, wallet provider and regulated custodian.

moves.title: UK plans one payments framework for stablecoins and tokenised deposits
moves.summary: HM Treasury set out plans for a single, coherent framework covering traditional and tokenised payments, including stablecoins and tokenised deposits, and to consult on payments by AI agents.

moves.title: Coinbase lists tGBP, its first sterling stablecoin
moves.summary: Coinbase listed tGBP, a pound-backed stablecoin issued by BCP Technologies, for users worldwide from 22 April.

moves.title: MoonPay buys MPC security firm Sodot in a $100m stock deal
moves.summary: MoonPay acquired Israeli MPC custody technology firm Sodot in an all-stock deal worth about $100m, per Bloomberg, to underpin MoonPay Institutional, a new unit for financial institutions led by former acting CFTC chair Caroline Pham.

moves.title: Bakkt completes its purchase of stablecoin firm DTR
moves.summary: Bakkt completed its all-stock acquisition of Distributed Technologies Research, issuing 11.3m shares and combining its licences with DTR's agentic payments and stablecoin infrastructure.

deal.rationale: stablecoin and agentic payments infrastructure

moves.title: FIS and six US banks launch Project Keystone for bank-run tokens
moves.summary: FIS announced Project Keystone, a network for tokenised money built on regulated deposits and controlled by banks, with Citizens, Fifth Third, Huntington, KeyBank and M&T among the first participants.

moves.title: Kraken and MoneyGram link crypto to cash at retail locations

moves.summary: Slash Financial launched Global Cards, Visa cards for international businesses without a US entity, running on Rain's infrastructure and Slash's USDSL stablecoin.

moves.summary: The Solana Foundation and Google Cloud launched Pay.sh, so AI agents can find and pay per request in stablecoins for Google Cloud services such as Gemini and BigQuery and over 50 community APIs.

moves.title: BNY expands digital asset custody to Abu Dhabi

moves.title: Corpay adds stablecoin settlement through BVNK and Kinexys
moves.summary: Corpay signed agreements with J.P. Morgan's Kinexys and BVNK to add stablecoin and tokenised fiat settlement to its cross-border payments platform.

moves.title: OpenTrade raises $17m to link stablecoin yield to real-world assets
moves.summary: London-based OpenTrade, which lets fintechs offer stablecoin yield products backed by real-world assets, raised $17m led by Mercury Fund and Notion Capital with a16z crypto, AlbionVC and CMCC Global, taking its total past $30m.

moves.title: AWS launches stablecoin payments for AI agents with Coinbase, Stripe
moves.summary: Amazon Web Services launched Bedrock AgentCore Payments, letting AI agents buy APIs, web content and online services with stablecoins, built with Coinbase and Stripe; bookings and merchant payments are to follow.

moves.title: Kraken's parent agrees to buy stablecoin payments firm Reap for $600m
moves.summary: Payward, Kraken's parent, agreed to buy Hong Kong-based Reap Technologies, which links business payments with digital assets and stablecoin settlement, in a $600m cash-and-stock deal valuing Payward at $20bn, per Bloomberg.

moves.title: Mastercard and Yellow Card partner on stablecoin payments across EEMEA
moves.summary: Mastercard and Yellow Card partnered to advance stablecoin payments in Eastern Europe, the Middle East and Africa, including cross-border remittances and digital loyalty.

moves.title: Exodus launches XO Cash for AI agent payments on Solana
moves.summary: Exodus launched XO Cash, a dollar stablecoin on Solana built with MoonPay, with a toolkit that lets AI agents pay for services without holding users' private keys.

moves.title: Kraken's parent applies for an OCC national trust charter
moves.summary: Payward applied to the OCC for a federally regulated trust company offering crypto custody, adding to the group's Wyoming bank charter and Fed master account.

moves.title: Stablecoin bank Augustus raises $40m and wins a rare OCC charter
moves.summary: Augustus, founded in 2022 and already licensed in Europe to clear cross-border euro payments for clients such as Kraken, raised $40m from Valar Ventures and Creandum and won an OCC national bank charter to rebuild correspondent banking.

round.use_of_funds: a US clearing bank for dollar payments

moves.title: Senate Banking Committee unveils CLARITY Act text before markup
moves.summary: The Senate Banking Committee released the latest text of the CLARITY Act, the crypto market structure bill, ahead of its committee vote.

moves.title: Neuberger Berman provides $200m facility to Ripple Prime

round.use_of_funds: margin financing at Ripple Prime

moves.title: Boundary raises $2m pre-seed led by Galaxy for stablecoin USBD

moves.title: Turnkey raises $12.5m with Circle Ventures and Archetype
moves.summary: Wallet and key-management infrastructure firm Turnkey raised $12.5m in a strategic round from Archetype, Circle Ventures and existing investors including Sequoia, taking its total past $65m, mainly to launch Turnkey Verifiable Cloud.

moves.title: Indonesia's OJK rejects Fasset's crypto trader licence application
moves.summary: OJK rejected PT Gerbang Aset Digital, Fasset's Indonesian arm, as a digital financial asset trader, revoked its registration as a prospective crypto trader and barred it from crypto business in Indonesia, telling it to settle its obligations to customers.

moves.title: Latvia licenses Nodu under MiCA and as a payment institution
moves.summary: Latvijas Banka licensed Nodu Digital SIA for crypto-asset services (exchange for funds and transfers for clients) and as a payment institution, its tenth MiCA licence; the authorisation can be passported across the EU.

moves.title: SCB launches stablecoin remittances on Lightnet, with Fireblocks
moves.summary: Siam Commercial Bank, Thailand's oldest bank, began offering round-the-clock stablecoin cross-border payments and remittances through Lightnet, on Fireblocks infrastructure, after testing the service in the Bank of Thailand's regulatory sandbox.

moves.title: Emirates NBD to join Partior for dirham, riyal and rupee settlement
moves.summary: Emirates NBD agreed to join Partior's blockchain clearing and settlement network as its first UAE dirham, Saudi riyal and Indian rupee settlement bank, also acting for major foreign currencies, and is weighing an equity investment through its innovation fund.

moves.title: Thunes joins Circle Payments Network's managed payments
moves.summary: Thunes joined Circle Payments Network Managed Payments, so its customers can settle with stablecoins while keeping their fiat workflows.

moves.title: KuCoin and Lightnet explore a South-East Asia payments tie-up
moves.summary: KuCoin and Lightnet said they are exploring collaboration that would combine KuCoin's trading ecosystem with Lightnet's licensed cross-border settlement network across South-East Asia, within local regulatory frameworks.

moves.title: Dubai-based Kora adds stablecoin payments for African businesses
moves.summary: Kora, a Dubai-headquartered payments provider serving African markets, added USDT and USDC to its platform: merchants can receive, hold, exchange and settle stablecoins alongside fiat and pay out to local bank accounts through its existing network.
